items.title: Family of man who died after being restrained by police sues for answers
items.description: The family of Kumanjayi White has launched legal action seeking answers over who made the decision not to pursue charges against the police officers involved in the 24-year-old's death.

items.title: Get ready for the AusAlert emergency warning test
items.description: Australia is about to get its first taste of a new nationwide emergency warning system, where millions of devices across the country are expected to sound off simultaneously later today.

items.title: Kogan running 'clone' website selling same products at higher prices
items.description: An ABC investigation has discovered that leading online retailer Kogan is operating a second website called Exclusive Brands, selling the same products with large price hikes.

items.title: Labor's command and control culture may come with a cost
items.description: Anthony Albanese's tightly managed Labor conference showcased discipline over dissent. But could shutting down public debate carry risks beyond the party room?

items.title: Alleged attacker at Berlin Pride event shot dead by German police
items.description: A nationwide manhunt in Germany ends as details about the suspected attacker, Abdul B, who was born in Germany in 2005, begin to emerge.

items.title: Luke Bateman earned $400K a year and gambled away every cent
items.description: Luke Bateman was 19 and living out his NRL dream when he went to a casino for the first time. It kick-started a gambling addiction, and he retired from sport $250,000 in debt.

items.title: They promise you 'grown in Australia'. Here's where tests say they're really from
items.description: One of Australia's biggest tomato brands and two major supermarkets are selling products that exclusive forensic testing shows have misleading labelling.

items.title: Victorian premier facing leadership challenge this week
items.description: Factional convenors from both the right and left of the party room met on Sunday night to discuss whether Jacinta Allan still had the support of a majority of caucus. The ABC understands they agreed she did not.

items.title: Live: Aussie 'best friends' lead another medal rush in the pool
items.description: Gemma Sellick and Victoria Belando Nicholson spark a rush of pool medals for Australia, including a gold for Tim Hodge, with more finals still to come. Follow live.

items.title: Hopes US and Iran will return to negotiating table after lull in hostilities
items.description: Iran has passed another night without US air strikes, as Washington pauses a war nearing its fifth month and reports emerge that concerns over dwindling munitions are restraining plans for further escalation.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
